project_type: Go HTTP service — a config-driven rules/API engine (stdlib net/http edge, interpreter over a flow tree, ZEN decisions via CGO, Postgres/Valkey/REST connectors, Postgres-backed config store with optional Valkey cache)
build_system: go modules (module nzr-rules-engine, go 1.26.0). CGO_ENABLED=1 is REQUIRED for the full tree because internal/decision links the embedded GoRules ZEN native library (-lzen_ffi); a glibc C toolchain (gcc/cc) must be on PATH. A CGO_ENABLED=0 build compiles only via the !cgo stub (internal/decision/zen_stub.go) and refuses ZEN at runtime. There is a Makefile with build/test/test-integration/vet targets, all exporting CGO_ENABLED=1.
test_framework: Go standard testing. Unit tests use fakes only (no Docker/network). Integration tests are build-tagged `//go:build integration && cgo` and spin up EPHEMERAL docker containers (postgres:16, valkey:8-alpine) on random host ports via a proven in-repo harness.
test_command: CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./...   (unit)  |  CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -tags 'integration cgo' ./internal/httpapi   (integration)
verification_instructions: 1) CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./... exits 0. 2) CGO_ENABLED=1 go vet ./... clean. 3) CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./... all pass. 4) CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./internal/decision exits 0 (ZEN stub compiles). 5) CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -tags 'integration cgo' ./internal/httpapi passes with Docker up (ops + dynamic-routing + FMC flows), EPHEMERAL containers only — never connect to a user/external DB.
environment_constraints: Build/verify against EPHEMERAL postgres:16 + valkey ONLY; NEVER connect to a user/external DB (the orchestrator runs the live demo afterward). Docker must be UP for integration tests. Go 1.26, go.mod floor 1.26, CGO_ENABLED=1 (ZEN). stdlib net/http only — no chi/gin. Work ONLY in the worktree /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/ops-demo on branch feat/ops-and-demo; use `git -C <worktree>` for git; commit locally, never push. All referenced paths must be absolute under that worktree. NOTE: the .codegraph index lives at the PARENT repo (/home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.codegraph) and reflects mainline; it may miss branch-local symbols — read files on disk in the worktree to be sure.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT change product-visible behavior beyond what the brief states. Keep the frozen config.Store interface coherent — ActiveRoutes is a deliberate seam addition implemented on BOTH memStore and PgStore. Use stdlib net/http (Go 1.22 method+pattern routing). Keep parameterized SQL (positional $1.. params only; the postgres driver rejects a mutating statement under query kind and treats 42xxx as Validation). Schema-qualify the FMC SQL (fmc_order.order_status). Never store or log secret values. Preserve the existing per-request edge adapters (templatingRegistry resolves {{input.x}} and {{data.path}} templates; branchingEvaluator promotes a sole JDM output to a branch — not needed for the decision-node path). ZEN decision-table rules: hitPolicy 'first', inputs reference row fields, outputs set the result field; mirror the shape of the existing 'order' JDM in seed.json.
key_patterns: ROUTING TODAY (the anti-pattern): internal/httpapi/server.go NewHandler builds a stdlib http.ServeMux and literally registers mux.HandleFunc("GET /orders/{id}", ordersHandler(...)). ordersHandler lifts r.PathValue("id") into Ctx.Input and calls store.ActiveFlow(ctx, "", "GET", "/orders/{id}") using the PATTERN (not the concrete path) as the stable key, then runs interp.Run and writes c.Response. The fix: enumerate active routes from the store and register ONE generic handler per route that reads the registered pattern + lifts ALL {name} wildcards via r.PathValue. STORE: config.Store (internal/config/store.go) is the frozen seam; ActiveFlow(ctx,env,method,path) resolves a flow; memStore keeps active[env][routeKey(method,path)] -> activeRef{FlowID,Version} and flows[env][flowID][version] -> FlowVersion (routeKey = method+" "+path). PgStore (internal/config/pgstore.go) resolves route->pointer->version via `flows` + `active_pointers` (object_type='flow'); there is NO list-routes method yet — add ActiveRoutes(ctx,env)([]RouteInfo,error) with RouteInfo{FlowID,Method,Path} on both. FLOW MODEL (internal/flow): node types trigger/action/condition/switch/decision/set/logger/response. A `decision` node (control_handlers.go decisionHandler) evaluates a JDM and stores the WHOLE output map under spec.saveAs in Ctx.Data (a leaf: no children walked — but ValidateTree treats decision as a leaf that MUST NOT own children). A `set` node (handlers.go setHandler) mounts spec.from (a GetPath) or spec.value into Response at spec.targetPath; set IS linear and walks its single child chain. So 'action set only via decision->Set' = decision(saveAs=dec) then set(targetPath=action, from=dec.action). GetPath precedence is Response>Data>Input; templates in action payloads use {{input.x}} (input. prefix stripped) resolved by httpapi/adapters.go templatingRegistry. The postgres driver returns rows as []map[string]any; normalizeResult unwraps a single row to a map so GetPath can read row fields. SEED: internal/config/testdata/seed.json carries flows+jdms+connections for env ""; memStore via LoadSeed/SeedFromBytes and PgStore via SeedPgStore both consume it (SeedPgStore MarkValidated's active flows because PgStore blocks publishing un-validated). OPS: internal/observ/metrics.go NewMetrics(reg prometheus.Registerer) registers nzr_flow_* / nzr_connection_* collectors; connect.Registry.HealthCheck(ctx) and config.Store.Ping(ctx) already exist for readyz. The slice-e LLD sketched a SEPARATE ops listener but the brief says MOUNT ON THE SAME mux — follow the brief. INTEGRATION HARNESS: internal/httpapi/integration_test.go has startPostgres(t) (ephemeral postgres:16, random port, polls ready) and overrideEndpoints/cloneSettings; internal/config/pgstore_integration_test.go has startPostgres/startValkey/newValkeyClient/dockerHostPort in package config_test. Reuse these patterns; do not reconnect to external DBs.
